name: always-emit-travel-line
description: Always emits a travel line, 0 SEK within 20 km (zero-amount lines are allowed).
search: if (distanceKm > FREE_KM) addLine('travel', (distanceKm - FREE_KM) * PER_KM_EX_VAT, false);
replace: addLine('travel', Math.max(0, distanceKm - FREE_KM) * PER_KM_EX_VAT, false);
